_note: Only one credible naked-eye-class prospect (mag ~6 or brighter) was found for late 2026–2027, and even it is a severe twilight target. Per the project rules, no fainter comets were padded in and no dates were guessed. Newly discovered comets can always outburst, so this list should be re-checked closer to 2027.
_source: J. D. Shanklin — Comet prospects for 2027 (people.ast.cam.ac.uk/~jds/preds27.pdf)

events.name: 2P/Encke
events.note: Bright on paper but nearly unobservable: peak brightness occurs only about 10° from the Sun, so this is an expert twilight target at best, not a practical backyard comet.
